A '''songwriter''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who was considered to have mastered the craft. They composed the song "[[Booombaaa Boombaa Bombashella]]" for the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[entertainer]] [[Anj'a]], which became a number-one [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] hit. One of Anj'a's performances of the song, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], inspired the [[Painting/Legends|painting]] ''[[Intense Performer]]'', copies of which were available for public purchase at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
This songwriter was mentioned in the description of the painting ''Intense Performer'', featured in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars: Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] after a [[2010]] contest. The winner, a player named Anj'a, had her painting and its backstory inserted into the game.
